_about: Copy to studio.config.json (setup.sh does it) and restart the server after any change. Every field is optional. Fields starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
name: Video Studio
_agent: The LaunchAgent label that runs the server. setup.sh fills it in; the Mac app and /run-videoapp use it.
_higgsfieldMcp: The Higgsfield MCP's tool prefix in `claude -p` sessions (one name or a list). Background runs get only these Higgsfield tools, and the paid guard watches them. /setup finds the right one.
_subjects: Extra library folders as { id: "Folder" }. Each character swap skill adds its own folder (its `folder:` line), and Other/ is always there, so this is usually empty.
_songsDir: Where the Songs tab looks for music (relative to the repo, or ~/…).
_postedDir: Optional: a folder of videos that are already posted; listed with Posted ticked.
_sourceDirs: Extra folders a card's original can be picked from (each subject's originals/ always counts).
_accounts: Social accounts a video can be queued or posted on, e.g. { "tiktok:mycat": "TikTok @mycat", "x:mycat": "X @mycat" }.
_brands: One per starring character, for the Buffer section: [{ "subject": "<swap skill name>", "name": "My Cat", "handle": "mycat", "accounts": ["tiktok:mycat", "x:mycat"], "voice": { "x": "how its X captions sound", "tiktok": "how its TikTok captions sound", "reply": "how it replies to comments" } }]. A Buffer channel whose handle contains `handle` counts as the brand's.
_finds: Optional lists of candidate clips to swap, shown as library tabs: { "<id>": { "label": "🎙 Someone", "list": "<id>-finds.json", "dir": "<folder with the clips' local copies>" } }. The list lives in video-library/ (same fields as the example in README.md).
